caption: The drawing features a wooden dresser set against a plain, light beige background. The dresser is rectangular and colored in a medium reddish-brown wood tone. The dresser stands on four short legs and has a total of twelve front-facing compartments. The upper section contains two square cabinet doors positioned at the center, each with a round, dark-colored knob for a handle. Beneath the cabinet doors are eight equally sized horizontal drawers arranged in two vertical columns, four drawers on each side. Each drawer is fitted with a single round, dark-colored knob, identical to those on the cabinet doors. The dresser is plain, with no additional decorative elements or embellishments, and the composition is centered on the page.
title: Shaker Chest of Drawers
